verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents a first-party Post-Incident Reviews product (formerly Jeli). PIRs can be started from the incident detail page or Slack, AI-generated PIRs are generally available, and PIRs build chronological narratives from incident lifecycle data, Slack data and Scribe Agent meeting transcripts, which covers drafting from the timeline. The evidence does not show postmortem templates, a review/approval step, or publication and sharing of finished reviews. Missing for 10: documented PIR templates, review/approval workflow, publication/distribution of completed postmortems, independent or hands-on corroboration.
